_description: Monitoring Trigger Conditions — compiled from README.md §3 + 交易执行系统 SOP. 15 trigger conditions with thresholds, alert levels, and push throttling rules.

triggers.label: 30Y UST
triggers.action: 大幅减仓高久期资产, 增配短债/现金

triggers.label: VIX
triggers.action: 立即减仓50%+, 启动对冲

triggers.label: 总账户回撤
triggers.action: 紧急审查, 暂停新增仓位
triggers.note: 回撤>15% → 暂停交易（系统硬止损）

triggers.label: 布伦特周涨
triggers.action: 评估油价→通胀传导 → 减仓高久期成长股

triggers.label: SPX破MA200
triggers.condition: 收盘跌破 MA200 且 斜率转负
triggers.action: 技术面趋势转空, 减仓美股

triggers.label: 10Y-2Y倒挂
triggers.action: 衰退预警信号, 降低风险暴露

triggers.label: CN PMI
triggers.action: 中国经济失速, 减仓CN暴露资产

triggers.label: 159632溢价
triggers.action: 溢价过高, 不追买 → 等待回落

triggers.label: 中美利差
triggers.action: 人民币贬值压力, CN资产估值折价加大

triggers.label: VIX自满
triggers.action: 市场过度自满, 收紧止损, 考虑对冲

triggers.label: 159682周跌
triggers.action: 创业板异常下跌, 排查原因

triggers.label: QQQ回撤-10%
triggers.action: 美股技术性调整, 开始减仓

triggers.label: QQQ回撤-15%
triggers.action: 美股深度调整, 大幅减仓, 考虑对冲

triggers.label: CPI+30Y机会
triggers.action: 通胀可控+长端利率下行 → 加仓成长股窗口

triggers.label: 159632溢价率
triggers.action: 停止买入159632, 已有仓位考虑减仓

push_throttling.same_trigger_24h: 禁止重复推送, 除非恶化 > 20%
push_throttling.no_actionless_push: 禁止推送不含建议操作的预警

time_slot_rules.intraday_0930_1500: 每30min交替扫描分组, 仅🔴🟠可推送
time_slot_rules.night_2300_0900: 仅 Tier1 新增触发可推送

hard_stops.drawdown_10pct: 紧急审查, 暂停新增仓位
hard_stops.drawdown_15pct: 暂停交易, 全面审查
hard_stops.consecutive_losses: 连续止损触发后, 暂停交易24h反省

_extensible: id 16-20 reserved for system health triggers (worker timeout, API failure, disk full, etc.)
